title: Beta sajjad Utho
body:
Beta sajjad utho
Sajjad utho
Beta Sajjad utho-3
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham E ghareeba'n me tha ZAINAB ka Nauha, Beta SAJJAD utho-2
Sham...
Jal gaye khaime mera koi bhi na raha.
<<MINI>>
Beta SAJJAD utho-2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham E ghareeba'n...
Beta-2
1) QASIM hain na ab ALI AKBAR qatl hue ABBAS E dilawar.
Khil gaya khil kar keh K gale par koi nahi ab monis O yawar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham E ghareeba'n..
Beta-2
2) Tashna labo'n k khoon me dubi karbobala KI paak zami'n hai, Malzoomo bewo'n ka sahara koi nahi ab koi nahi hai.
Sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
Beta...-2
3) Nanhe Mushahid gesuoo'n wale sher e jari ki maa ko sambhalo, Wo hai mere ASGHAR ki nishani jhule ko jalne se bachalo.
Sham...
Beta...-2
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Maar raha hai shimr tamache neel pade hain rukhsaro'n par, Sun sun k beti ki sadayen kaanp uth-ta hai laashaye SARWAR.
sham...
Beta...-2
5) Roko sitamgaro'n ko roko uttho mere beta uth jao, Sher se bete ko dekha hai khoo'n me nahaye barchi khaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham..
Beta..-2
6) Dekho zara kya zulm hua hai dekh hui hai kaisi tabahi, Itni tassali do KUBRA ko bewa hui ik raat ki biyahi.
Sham..
<<DIVIDER>>
Beta..-2
7) Maadar Kitni tadpi royi haye kisi ne Rehem na khaya, Teer laga ASGHAR k gale par Mara gaya besheer bhi pyasa.
Sham..
Beta..-2
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Sher se bete ko dekha hai khoo'n me nahaye barchi khaye, Dil pe jawa'n bete ka gham hai maa uski kahi'n mar na jaye.
Sham..
Beta..-2
